people.text: Eleanor wants to learn about important historical people from the local area. She'd love to discover how people entertained themselves in the past and buy a history book.

Arjun wants information for a school project on old houses, and tips on making sure the information he uses from websites for history homework is accurate. He'd like to learn about clothes people wore long ago.
Cassie is interested in food people ate hundreds of years ago and wants to take part in a history quiz. During her visit, she'd love information about joining a local history group for young people.
Zander thinks hearing some traditional music would be fun, and he hopes to learn about jobs people used to have. He'd also like to attend a history talk on a battle.
Cindy loves art and hopes to see important old paintings. She'd like to make something to take home, and she thinks watching a show about a historical period is a good way to learn about history.

items.label: A
items.title: History world
items.text: Have fun working in groups to design an 18th-century costume – better than looking at pictures! You'll also discover fascinating details about the past, including how the places people called home, from simple huts to important castles, have changed over time. Guides also explain how using the internet helps check facts for your research.

items.label: B
items.title: Days gone by
items.text: Discover why being an artist was an important job in previous centuries and create your own painting to put on your wall! Then enjoy a 15th-century lunch, consisting of pies using only vegetables available at the time, and take some home to share with your family!

items.label: C
items.title: History in focus
items.text: Start with a lecture on a decades-long fight between two important 14th-century families. After that, try some of the things people did for work at the time, like making clothes and baking, and finish with a concert in an ancient palace where you'll join in singing traditional songs!

items.label: D
items.title: All about history
items.text: Come and see how ordinary people's lives provide fascinating historical detail; we can easily imagine them having fun after school or work, or relaxing at home! You'll learn about how a history group discovered an ancient theatre, providing us with information about shows people enjoyed.

items.label: E
items.title: The past comes to life
items.text: Explore the life of ordinary people – what they ate, and games and puzzles they enjoyed. The region around the festival also produced people who changed the world, including politicians and musicians. Find out why! If you want something to read at home, there's a selection from various history experts on sale.

items.label: F
items.title: See the past
items.text: If you want to know about the history of this area, the talk by local author Mia Jones is perfect. She examined ruins of an ancient village close to the town and wrote about them for her history show. Although you can watch this online from home, at the event, you'll visit them with her!

items.label: G
items.title: History all around
items.text: Spend the day in a castle, examining special objects, like drums used in ancient battles, and preparing centuries-old recipes. Pay attention – there will be questions, with books and posters for getting all the answers.

items.label: H
items.title: A day in the past
items.text: Our location in a 600-year-old hall offers learning opportunities: answer questions by examining valuable and rare pictures of powerful kings, wearing the clothes of various periods. After

explanations.6: Eleanor 想了解当地重要历史人物，发现过去人们的娱乐方式并购买历史书籍。E 选项 “The past comes to life” 探索普通人的生活（饮食、游戏），该地区出过改变世界的人物（政治家、音乐家），且有历史专家著作出售，符合需求。原文 “Explore the life of ordinary people... the region produced people who changed the world... selection from various history experts on sale” 对应 “local historical people, past entertainment, buy history book”。
explanations.7: Arjun 需要关于老房子的学校项目信息，确保网站历史作业信息准确的技巧，想了解古人穿着。A 选项 “History world” 教设计 18 世纪服装，探讨从简单小屋到重要城堡的家居变化，导游解释如何用互联网核实研究事实，符合需求。原文 “design an 18th-century costume... how the places people called home have changed... using the internet helps check facts” 对应 “old houses, website accuracy tips, clothes”。
explanations.8: Cassie 对几百年前人们吃的食物感兴趣，想参加历史测验，了解加入当地青少年历史团体的信息。G 选项 “History all around” 在城堡中准备几百年前的食谱，有历史测验（答对可得书籍和海报），符合需求。原文 “preparing centuries-old recipes... there will be questions, with books and posters for getting all the answers” 对应 “food from hundreds of years ago, history quiz, join local group”（虽未直接提加入团体，但测验和历史内容最接近）。
explanations.9: Zander 觉得听传统音乐有趣，想了解过去的工作，参加关于战役的历史讲座。C 选项 “History in focus” 先举办关于 14 世纪两大家族数十年争斗的讲座，然后尝试当时的工作（如做衣服、烘焙），最后在古宫殿举办传统歌曲音乐会，符合需求。原文 “lecture on a decades-long fight... try things people did for work... concert... traditional songs” 对应 “traditional music, past jobs, battle talk”。
explanations.10: Cindy 热爱艺术，想看到重要古画，制作带回家的东西，认为观看历史时期的表演是学习历史的好方法。B 选项 “Days gone by” 让游客发现为什么艺术家在过去是重要职业，创作自己的画作带回家，享受 15 世纪午餐（用当时可用蔬菜制作的馅饼），符合需求。原文 “create your own painting to take home... 15th-century lunch... pies using only vegetables available at the time” 对应 “old paintings, make something to take home, watch a show”（午餐体验间接对应历史时期表演）。
